newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 483.25/484.25/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 483.25/484.25/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed soft at 483.25/484.25 per dollar despite a 235 basis points back-up in six month TEM yields to 20.15 percent and only after Central Bank dollar sales boosted the bolivar from a mid-session low of 484.75, traders said.
The unit closed Tuesday at 482.75/483.75 per dollar.
The bolivar slumped in the morning "because some banks were short dollars," said one trader. "But the Central Bank came in the afternoon and calmed the market."

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
Despite the bumpy ride, traders said the market was nonetheless calmer than Tuesday as overnight rates fell to between 20 and 45 percent from 60 to 75 percent levels.
"The liquidity crunch is largely over ... For Friday we're looking a five percent levels again," said one trader.
